downloads.name: Project Development Starter Pack
downloads.summary: Three connected files (HTML, CSS, JavaScript) with a built-in connection check, a finished example, and a README-FIRST guide.
downloads.description: Unzip, open the my-project folder in VS Code, and click Test my JavaScript to confirm every file is linked. Includes commented starter files, checkpoints, challenges, troubleshooting, credits, and a finished project-log example.

downloads.name: Browser Game Builder — Guided Starter Pack
downloads.summary: A complete canvas game that teaches input, update, collision, rendering, and state through comments and checkpoints.
downloads.description: Run Signal Sweep immediately, then learn by changing one rule at a time. Includes commented HTML/CSS/JavaScript, README-FIRST tutorial, three levels of challenges, troubleshooting, credits, and a finished reference that adds dash, lives, and a best time.

downloads.name: Pygame Arcade — Guided Starter Pack
downloads.summary: A runnable catch game that teaches Pygame's event, update, collision, and render loop.
downloads.description: Includes a heavily commented main.py, environment setup, checkpoints, graduated challenges, troubleshooting, credits, and a finished reference with lives and rising difficulty.

downloads.name: Creative Coding + Demoscene — Guided Starter Pack
downloads.summary: Three generative scenes connecting color, sine waves, smooth noise, time, and real-time visual design.
downloads.description: Signal Garden runs without libraries and includes Flow Field, Wave Choir, and Star Tunnel scenes, live controls, PNG export, an offline tutorial, challenges, reference presets, troubleshooting, and licensing guidance.

downloads.name: Godot Adventure — Guided Starter Pack
downloads.summary: A dependency-free Godot 4 collection game with player, camera, signals, HUD, win state, and extension path.
downloads.description: Open Signal Run and play immediately. The pack includes readable scenes and GDScript, a guided architecture tutorial, checkpoints, challenges, troubleshooting, credits, and a working dash extension to compare against.

downloads.name: Kaplay 2D Game — Guided Starter Pack
downloads.summary: Coin Climb: a complete KAPLAY platformer with the engine bundled, so it runs offline from a double-click.
downloads.description: Includes commented game.js, a pinned copy of KAPLAY 3001, README-FIRST tutorial on components, checkpoints, challenges, troubleshooting, credits, and a finished reference with double jump, an enemy, lives, and a timer.

downloads.name: Phaser 3 Game — Guided Starter Pack
downloads.summary: Star Hop: a complete Phaser 3 platformer with the engine bundled and art drawn by code, so it runs offline.
downloads.description: Includes commented scenes, arcade physics, and input, a pinned copy of Phaser 3.90, README-FIRST tutorial, checkpoints, challenges, troubleshooting, credits, and a finished reference with double jump, a bouncing hazard, lives, and a timer.

downloads.name: Arduino Starter Sketches Pack
downloads.summary: Three commented sketches (non-blocking blink, sensor reading, servo sweep) with parts lists and wiring for each.
downloads.description: Includes BlinkWithoutDelay, SensorReading, and MotorControl, a README-FIRST setup guide, challenges, troubleshooting, credits, and a finished SensorToServo example that combines all three without delay().

downloads.name: VR Demo — Godot 4 Starter Project
downloads.summary: Ready-to-run Godot 4 VR project with scene, scripts, materials, and OpenXR setup included.
downloads.description: Unzip and open in Godot 4. Includes Main.tscn, Main.gd, Scenes, Materials, Meshes, and Images folders with OpenXR addons pre-configured. Works with Meta Quest via Link cable or SteamVR. Use this as your starting point for the VR lesson build task.

downloads.name: Godot 4.6.1 for Windows
downloads.summary: Direct GitHub download for the Godot editor students need to open the VR template on Windows.
downloads.description: Download the editor ZIP directly from the official Godot GitHub release, unzip it, and launch the Godot executable. This is the exact engine download students need to open the VR starter project on Windows.

downloads.name: Godot 4.6.1 for Mac
downloads.summary: Direct GitHub download for the Godot editor students need to open the VR template on macOS.
downloads.description: Download the editor ZIP directly from the official Godot GitHub release, unzip it, and open the Godot app. This is the exact engine download students need to open the VR starter project on Mac.

downloads.name: Godot 4.6.1 Export Templates
downloads.summary: Direct GitHub download for the export templates used when students are ready to package their VR game.
downloads.description: Download the official export templates directly from the Godot GitHub release. Students only need this when they are exporting a runnable build instead of just opening and editing the template project.
